market_question: Will Kolkata Knight Riders win the 2026 Indian Premier League?
reasoning: In a 10-team IPL, a simple equal-chance baseline gives every team a 10% probability to win. KKR is a historically strong franchise, winning the 2024 title and often fielding competitive squads. The market's implied 2% is an extreme under-estimate, likely due to low liquidity and no fundamental reason. True probability is at least 10%, offering a sizable edge.
evidence_points: IPL has 10 teams; purely random draw would assign 10% to each side.
KKR won the 2024 IPL and has made multiple playoffs, demonstrating above-average strength.
Market price of 2% implies KKR would win roughly once every 50 seasons, which contradicts league parity.
sources_consulted: Historical IPL winner records (2012, 2014, 2024 KKR titles)
